description: Run parameterized SQL against Postgres: read-only by default, with an optional table allowlist.

inputs.help: read-only runs every query in a READ ONLY transaction that Postgres enforces. read-write commits, and marks the generic query tool destructive.

inputs.prompt: Tables the tool may use, comma-separated schema.table (empty = no allowlist)
inputs.help: Optional allowlist of schema.table names (lowercase), e.g. public.orders,public.customers. Queries touching other tables are refused. Empty means no allowlist.

inputs.prompt: Expose the generic query tool (on or off)
inputs.help: off leaves out the free-form query tool, so the model only gets list_tables, describe_table and spec-defined tools. Recommended once spec-defined tools cover what is needed.
Never collected or written to disk. Set DATABASE_URL in the MCP client entry, ideally for a least-privilege role.
